video:video.video:title: Turn Customer Meeting Notes into Quote Changes | Quotiflex Deal Journal
video:video.video:description: Write the note the way you always do. With one click, the AI in Quotiflex suggests changes to the quote, updates to the deal brief and a task, each with the sentence it came from. The rules check every suggestion, and you decide what to apply.

video:video.video:title: Never Forget a Machine Accessory on a Quote | Quotiflex Accessory Rules
video:video.video:description: Add a machine, and its usual accessories come with it. Every choice shows the price difference and the rule behind it. Take off something mandatory, and the quote shows it at once. To leave it out, you give a reason, and the reason stays with the quote under your name.

video:video.video:title: Bilingual Quotation Documents, Nothing Typed Twice | Quotiflex Documents
video:video.video:description: The quote opens as the document your customer will read: two languages side by side, every machine with its description, pictures and price. What you sent stays exactly as you sent it. To change a text, click it and type; the prices come from the quote, so nobody types a wrong number.

video:video.video:title: Discount Approvals with a Reason, Decided in Minutes | Quotiflex Approvals
video:video.video:description: Below the price floor, the quote says why in plain words, and its main button asks for approval. You ask with a reason, and the quote waits, read-only, until someone decides. The approver sees the difference in money, not only in percent, and decides with a reason in one click.
